{{RV|type=function

|gr1= Vectors

|descr= Dot product of two vectors. {{Feature|arma3|In {{arma3}} use [[vectorDotProduct]].}}

|s1= [vector1, vector2] call [[BIS_fnc_dotProduct]]

|p1= vector1: [[Array]]

|p2= vector2: [[Array]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>[[1,2,3], [1,2,3]] call BIS_fnc_dotProduct; // returns: 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 = 14</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[[1,2,3,4], [1,2,3,4]] call BIS_fnc_dotProduct; // returns 1*1 + 2*2 + 3*3 + 4*4 = 30</sqf>

|seealso= [[vectorDotProduct]]
